svg.title: Reaching Matura, by parents' education
svg.desc: Population-weighted mosaic with two groups on both axes: below Matura (compulsory school or apprenticeship/VET), and Matura or higher (Matura or a university/college degree). Parents increase left to right; children bottom to top. The original parent categories in each band are merged using their population proportions. The 2007 and 2011/12 proportions are extrapolated; 2016/17 and 2022/23 use observed totals. Between surveys, source percentages are interpolated before merging.

rect.title: Below Matura: children Matura or higher
Matura or higher: children Below Matura
Matura or higher: children Matura or higher

svg.text: Below Matura = compulsory school or VET. Matura or higher = Matura or a university/college degree.
Statistics Austria, Adult Education Survey 2007, 2011/12, 2016/17, 2022/23; Bildung in Zahlen 2018/19 and 2024/25, table 5.1_9a.
Parents' education is the higher of mother and father. Degree includes colleges; 2007 and 2011/12 group it slightly differently.
